text.description_html:
Bommer 175-19-630, 19" Heavy Duty Stainless Steel Bumper Guard

Packaged completed with one (1) 19" x 10" Bumper Guard, one (1) Back Plate, one (1) Mounting Plate plus six (6) 5/16-18 thru bolts and nuts (bolt length for standard for 1-3/4" thick door).

The taller 10" high door Bumper Guard is heavy duty .109" thick stainless steel (ANSI K57434). The included back plate protects the face of the door from wear caused by sliding motion of the Bumper Guard.

Used to protect hospitals doors against gurneys (gurney door guards). Also used on commercial doors such as warehouses and factory doors that are run into with carts and forklifts. For use on wood and metal doors.

Can be install on one side of a single acting door or back to back on double acting doors (door swings in both directions). Note: Back to back installation requires Two (2) Bumpers.

Specifications for the Bommer 175-19-630 Door Bumper Guard:

  • Material: .109" Stainless Steel (Heavy Duty)
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Bumper Guard Length: 19"
  • Bumper Guard Height: 10"
  • Bumper Guard Projection: 4"
  • Machine Screws with Nuts: 5/16-18
  • Bommer 175 Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Sold Individually.



** This item is Discontinued.
